name: ECA Webprofiler
description: Integrate ECA with the Webprofiler module: adds an 'ECA' data collector, toolbar item and profiler panel that show the ECA logger messages and the token/data values available during a request.
project_description: ECA Webprofiler integrates the ECA (Event-Condition-Action) module with the Webprofiler developer toolbar. It registers an 'ECA' Symfony data collector and decorates ECA's logger channel so that, during each request, the ECA log messages and the token/data values ECA had available are captured and displayed in a dedicated Webprofiler toolbar item and profiler panel. It ships no routes, permissions, config or Drush commands of its own — it is a pure developer/debugging aid reachable through Webprofiler's own gated profiler UI.
